description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_mailto' that extends 'HTMLPurifier_URIScheme'. It handles validation of mailto URIs according to RFC 2368, primarily by ensuring email address validity and filtering query parameters. The class specifies whether the URI is browsable and whether it can omit the host component.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_mailto
classes.description: A class to handle validation of mailto URIs in compliance with RFC 2368, allowing for email address validation and parameter filtering.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates the mailto URI by clearing user info, host, and port components, and returns true indicating hypothetical validation success.
